notes.title: “No one can snatch them out of My hand”
notes.intro: Jesus promises that his sheep will never perish.

views.label: True believers are kept to the end
views.summary: Reformed Christians and many Baptists see here a promise that those Christ saves will persevere.

views.label: No outside power can snatch them, but people can walk away
views.summary: Others hold that the promise protects believers from outside forces, while they remain free to turn away from Christ.
views.source: Methodist Articles of Religion, Article XII

notes.common: See the Big Question “Can you lose your salvation?”
